summary: Brightsolid's Aberdeen facility is a purpose-built Tier III-certified colocation data centre in the Mastrick/Whitemyres area of Aberdeen, opened in 2017 and notable as the main commercial colocation site serving the north-east and the oil and gas sector. Public material describes a ~1 MW IT load initially, a ~2 MW two-hall design with up to 400 high-density racks (25 kW/rack) and Ecofris cooling at ~1.25 PUE. Brightsolid is part of Dundee-based DC Thomson; it also operates a Dundee data centre.
maturity_explanation: Opened 2017 per Data Center Dynamics and operator technical specification; still marketed as operating in directories as of July 2026.
unknowns: Current built-out capacity vs the 2 MW two-hall design
